event: 2025 ILCA 6 Women's & ILCA 7 Men's World Championships
procedural_matters: The race committee was represented by Hugh Leicester (Course Representative).
ITA 219260 was represented by Antonio Pascali.
Dongning Zhou (member of the international jury) and Joaquim Coutinho (coach of ITA 219260) attended the hearing as observers.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The race committee did not come to the hearing when the international jury gave the decision.
facts: Race 5 on 17 May 2025 of the ILCA 7 blue fleet was started using a Uniform flag as the preparatory signal.
ITA 219260 approached the starting line closer to the race committee starting vessel side of the line.
The race committee identified ITA 219260 inside the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last second before the starting signal.
ITA 219260 was scored UFD in race 5.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor an improper omission of the race committee by scoring ITA 219260 UFD in race 5. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met. Rules: 61.4(b)(1) and N1.4(b)
